notes.en: Added JBIG2 image decoding and improved Windows file opening with single-instance handoff, duplicate-tab detection and recovery when the primary instance exits. Added options to open or move document tabs into a new window, clearer unsaved-edit indicators and safer transfer prompts, with centered, draggable confirmation dialogs.
